note: Lane County KS parcels are only viewable through the county's Aumentum parcel search portal (ks-gis-lane.publicaccessnow.com), a search form with no GIS export or ArcGIS REST service; registered access goes through the Appraiser's Office. The legacy lane.kansasgis.com site lists no service URLs. The state ORKA portal provides county parcels only by request, and the KS_ORKA_Extras service has no Lane County parcel layer. Lane County parcel polygons are otherwise sold by commercial vendors. No public queryable county parcel service was found.
